en: Vintage sepia postcard divided into two main photographs framed with floral ornamentation. The left photo shows a statue of a standing man on a high pedestal in a landscaped setting. The right photo depicts a river with industrial mill buildings and chimneys along the banks and a bridge in the background. Russian and German captions are printed under the right image identifying the location, and there is handwritten German text and a date at the bottom.
